notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Agent Frank Horrigan.
When Agent Frank Horrigan enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to put two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
